leads.title: Bahia anti-discrimination ordinance (1997)
leads.documents: First state-level anti-discrimination ordinance in Brazil; foundational LGBTQ protection in Bahia
leads.detail: No URL visible; cited as 1997 ordinance, Bahia was first Brazilian state to enact

leads.title: Millena Passos Law - Legislative Assembly of Bahia anti-discrimination bill
leads.documents: Bans discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in the state of Bahia
leads.detail: No URL visible; passed June 1, 2022, signed into law June 30, 2022 by Assembly President Adolfo Menezes; named in honor of transgender activist Millena Passos

leads.title: Governor Rui Costa decree on social name (May 23, 2017)
leads.documents: Grants transgender people right to use social name instead of legal name; social name must be accompanied by legal name, minors require guardian authorization
leads.detail: No URL visible; signed May 23, 2017 by Governor Rui Costa

leads.title: Court of Justice of the State of Bahia ruling on third gender option
leads.documents: Allowed third gender option on documents in Bahia

leads.title: Law 14,806 / Lei 14.806
leads.documents: Establishes exemption from costs for protest certificates, making document rectification free of charge for transgender people
leads.detail: No URL visible; sanctioned December 26, 2024 by Governor Jeronimo Rodrigues

leads.title: Salvador municipal law banning teaching of gender identity in schools
leads.documents: Bans teaching of gender identity in Salvador schools; restricts education-related gender-identity recognition
leads.detail: No URL visible; approved December 17, 2025 by Salvador City Council, signed March 26, 2026 by Mayor Bruno Soares Reis (UNIAO)

leads.title: Grupo Gay da Bahia (GGB) 2004 report on murders and abuses
leads.documents: Human-rights report listing names of 159 murdered LGBTQ community members in that year plus list of alleged human rights abuses
leads.detail: No URL visible; attributed to Grupo Gay da Bahia, 2004, oldest gay rights organization founded 1980 in Salvador

leads.title: Camaçari 2022 homophobic attack case
leads.documents: Documented incident of homophobic attacks on teenager in Camacari with national repercussions and mobilization of state authorities
leads.detail: No URL visible; cited as notorious 2022 case in Camacari

leads.title: Salvador court adoption ruling (March 9, 2010)
leads.documents: Court authorization of child adoption by lesbian couple in Salvador
leads.detail: No URL visible; court in Salvador, March 9, 2010
